request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Reconcile federated authority and block unsafe mutation.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: Typed authority assertions, conflict detection, unknown handling, and a mutation gate are absent.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: Typed authority assertions, conflict detection, unknown handling, and a mutation gate are absent.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Configuration cannot add a versioned typed decision contract with fail-closed semantics.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Composition can order existing capabilities but cannot create the missing semantic contract.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Reconcile federated authority and block unsafe mutation.
proposed_primitive.side_effects: in-memory receipt or manifest construction only
proposed_primitive.idempotency: deterministic for fixed inputs and timestamps
proposed_primitive.logging: caller records identifiers, dispositions, and digests without raw secrets
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: incomplete or unsafe decision state fails closed

approval.rationale: Approved as part of the operating-contract component and gap plan.
